threshold_selection: Validation balanced accuracy; middle of a near-optimal plateau; frozen before test evaluation.

test_confusion_matrix_reconstructed.note: Counts reproduce the recorded test metric fractions and support, but are reconstructed from the metric summary because the original V3 per-image prediction export was not recovered.

roc_curve: Not reconstructed. Per-image y_true and sigmoid scores were not available; AUC alone cannot reconstruct the ROC coordinates.
limitations: Keras directory loader skipped 2 train, 3 validation and 2 test WebP files.
V3 metrics use 872 train, 185 validation and 186 test images.
Source groups overlap across splits; no held-out-generator test was performed.
Labels were inherited from source manifests/folders.
